verdict.rationale: Retell has a broad programmatic surface. Its official SDKs claim full voice and chat endpoint coverage, the CLI manages agents, phone numbers and knowledge bases, the MCP server covers agent lifecycle operations, and some UI actions like voice cloning have API references. However, no document claims API–UI parity, and several dashboard features have no evidenced API equivalent: Conductor, analytics dashboards, AI QA configuration and data-retention settings. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage for analytics dashboards, AI QA, Conductor and retention settings, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
